verdict.rationale: Docs confirm ROCm-based inference stack support for vLLM and SGLang, plus explicit MXFP6/MXFP4 low-precision datatype support and large HBM3E memory for LLM inference. However, the story also asks about TensorRT-LLM and llama.cpp support, and explicit FP8 support, none of which appear in the evidence pack. missing for 10: TensorRT-LLM support evidence, llama.cpp support evidence, explicit FP8 precision documentation, independent benchmarks validating inference throughput on these stacks.
